title: Creator card family
slide_intent: Use a repeatable frame to support varied individuals because people should retain their own identity within the platform.
strategic_value: The shared signature and handle placement can connect three creators without making their clothing or expressions uniform.
demonstration: Valkyrae, DrLupo and AnneMunition appear in three cards with Twitch signatures overhead and slash-prefixed handles below.
practical_value: Compare how light and dark card backgrounds support different portraits while preserving the same reading order.

content_islands.name: Three-card row
content_islands.spec: Align the cards horizontally, keeping the Twitch signature above each portrait.

content_islands.name: Names and contrast
content_islands.spec: Place slash-prefixed handles at the bottom; use pale cards at the sides and a black center card.

reference_purposes.Application: The same portrait-card arrangement is applied to three named creators.
reference_purposes.Expression: Different portrait expressions and gradient accents coexist within the repeated frame.
